moved.sentence: Catch the narrowest exception that you can handle.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: catch the narrowest exception you can handle.

moved.sentence: Never write a bare `except:`, and do not catch `Exception` except at a process boundary that logs and exits.

judged.note: Both halves kept: bare except at MUST NOT, catching Exception at SHOULD NOT with the process-boundary-that-logs-and-exits exception.

moved.sentence: Define your own errors as subclasses of `Exception`, named with the suffix `Error`.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: own errors subclass Exception and are named with the Error suffix.

moved.sentence: When you translate an exception, chain it: `raise ConfigError("...") from err`.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the condition (when translating) and the raise ... from err form.

moved.sentence: Use `from None` only to hide an implementation detail on purpose.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: from None only to hide an implementation detail on purpose.

moved.sentence: Keep the `try` body small.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: keep the try body small.

moved.sentence: Put code that runs only on success in `else`, and cleanup in `finally`.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: success-only code in else, cleanup in finally.

moved.sentence: Never `return`, `break` or `continue` out of a `finally` block; the 3.14 interpreter warns about it (PEP 765).

judged.note: Kept at MUST NOT for return, break and continue out of finally, with the PEP 765 reason.

moved.sentence: Add context to an in-flight exception with `add_note()` instead of wrapping it where you have nothing to add.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: add_note() instead of wrapping where there is nothing to add.

moved.sentence: Put optional extras in `[project.optional-dependencies]` and command-line entry points in `[project.scripts]`.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with both tables: optional-dependencies for extras, scripts for entry points.

moved.sentence: Do not write a `setup.py` for a new project.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD NOT with the new-project scope.

moved.sentence: Declare `requires-python` to match the oldest interpreter you test.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: requires-python matches the oldest tested interpreter.

moved.sentence: A typed library ships a `py.typed` marker file in the package (PEP 561) so type checkers use its annotations.

judged.note: Kept and strengthened from a description to SHOULD: typed libraries ship py.typed (PEP 561) so checkers use the annotations.

moved.sentence: Use `pathlib.Path`, not string concatenation or `os.path`.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: pathlib.Path rather than string concatenation or os.path.

moved.sentence: Join with `/`, read and write with `read_text` and `write_text`, and always pass `encoding="utf-8"`.

judged.note: Kept across two rules: join with / and read_text/write_text at SHOULD; always pass encoding="utf-8" at MUST.

moved.sentence: Create directories with `mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)` and search with `glob` and `rglob`.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True), glob and rglob.

moved.sentence: Resolve a path before you test whether it lies under a root.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the reason that only resolve() collapses .. and symlinks.

moved.sentence: Run external programs with `subprocess.run`, passing the command as a list: `subprocess.run(["git", "status"], check=True)`.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: subprocess.run with the command as a list, with the example.

moved.sentence: Never use `shell=True` with a string that contains any value you did not write yourself.

judged.note: Kept at MUST NOT: no shell=True with any value you did not write; the list-never-reaches-a-shell note is kept.

moved.sentence: If a shell is truly required, quote each interpolated value with `shlex.quote`.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the condition that a shell is truly required: shlex.quote each interpolated value.

moved.sentence: Pass `check=True` so a non-zero exit raises `CalledProcessError`, or inspect `returncode` on purpose.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with both alternatives: check=True raising CalledProcessError, or inspecting returncode on purpose.

moved.sentence: Pass `timeout=` for any command that could hang.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the could-hang condition; the TimeoutExpired note is kept.

moved.sentence: Use `capture_output=True` with `text=True` to read output.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: capture_output=True with text=True.

moved.sentence: Do not combine `capture_output` with explicit `stdout` or `stderr` arguments.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD NOT: no capture_output combined with explicit stdout or stderr.

moved.sentence: Build it from `os.environ` plus your changes unless you want a clean one.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with 'it' resolved to env, the unless-you-want-a-clean-one exception and the replaces-inherited-environment note.

moved.sentence: Annotate every function signature and every public attribute.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: every function signature and every public attribute annotated.

moved.sentence: Run a type checker in strict mode in CI (for mypy, `--strict`, which includes `--disallow-untyped-defs`).

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: strict type checking in CI, with the mypy --strict detail.

moved.sentence: Do not silence a checker with a blanket `# type: ignore`; ignore one error code and say why.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD NOT for blanket type: ignore, with the one-error-code-and-say-why alternative.

moved.sentence: Start it with `python -I` (isolated mode), which ignores the script directory, the user site-packages directory and every `PYTHON*` environment variable.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the untrusted-directory condition, what -I ignores, and the planted-file reason and -E -P -s note.

moved.sentence: Be aware that `-m` puts the current directory on `sys.path`, so do not use `-m` from an untrusted working directory.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD NOT with the sys.path reason and the untrusted-working-directory scope.

moved.sentence: Never run an interpreter inside a directory of downloaded files.

judged.note: Kept at MUST NOT: never run an interpreter inside a directory of downloaded files.

moved.sentence: Run it from your own directory and pass the downloaded path as an argument.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: run from your own directory and pass the downloaded path as an argument.
